label: Web platforms: Marketplace, Marketing, Services Platform, Identity, Rewards and Support, plus Conversational AI, Uvation Pulse, Atlas CRM, Devops and Design Marketing Development Collab
note: Web-Marketplace Product Catalog (PC) is reported with Web-Marketplace, because the AI-server catalogue work runs across both boards.

programmes.name: Web-Marketplace
programmes.headline: Privacy compliance (MT-1553) and its five review subtasks reached Ready for Prod on 13 Oct, and the RMA backend moved to Dev Test (MT-1565, MT-1566). The journey review (MT-1586) now has 6 of 13 reviews done. A new High bug was raised: Send a Quote approval does not register the customer in Identity (MT-1611); open bugs are 11. 21 items are past due, including the live chat platform choice and widget (MT-1578, MT-1579), still in Dev.

programmes.name: Web-Marketing
programmes.headline: The new home page (MR-1169) and its CMS work closed on 13 Oct, along with the platform review and next-sprint plan (MR-1336). The site-wide live chat widget (MR-754) and its platform choice (MR-786) moved to Code Review, and about 40 page fixes from Kannan Elangovan's review moved to Code Review or UAT. Smoke and privacy testing (MR-1277, MR-1279) went back to To Do. 14 items are past due; the sitemap fix (MR-1199) is still Ready for Prod and related products content (MR-1265) is still blocked.

programmes.name: Web-Uvation Services Platform
programmes.headline: Two Go Live payment subtasks were deployed in Dev on 13 Oct (USP-4281, USP-4282), joining the two payment stories deployed on 12 Oct. Two S1 bugs remain open: the Document API 502 (USP-4231, not started) and the subscription calculation 500 (USP-4204, in progress), both due 30 Oct. 103 items are past due, 65 of them untouched in 30 days.

programmes.name: Uvation Conversational AI
programmes.headline: Five chatbot bugs moved to Code Review on 13 Oct, including booking confirmation (UC-233) and Book a Meeting triggering support (UC-234). Model selection (UC-26) moved to In Dev and admin analytics (UC-25) started; with sign-in (UC-225) and the Teams handoff (UC-22) they are due 15 Oct. 27 items are past due, 26 of them untouched since August.

programmes.name: Uvation Pulse
programmes.headline: Sarath Chandra raised and started production configuration fixes for the Pulse status page (PULSE-331) on 13 Oct; the rest of the board is unchanged. Anshul Bhargava's Interactive AI Factory tasks sit on the PRD board, outside this report's boards.

programmes.name: Atlas CRM
programmes.headline: Saurabh Jain closed the CRM MVP scope and specification work (ATLAS-2) and the POC meeting (ATLAS-3) on 13 Oct, and two new subtasks on agentic lead conversion journeys started (ATLAS-4, ATLAS-5). The parent CRM MVP item (ATLAS-1) is still To Do with no due date.

programmes.name: Web-Identity
programmes.headline: No change on 13 Oct. The account deletion flow (ID-748 to ID-750) is in Dev Testing; the Klaviyo production notification bug (ID-758) is To Do. The 6 past-due claims-removal tasks (ID-679 to ID-684) are in production but not closed.

programmes.name: Web-Rewards
programmes.headline: No change on 13 Oct. The 18 regression-test items raised on 30 Sep are all To Do, unassigned and undated; one older bug (REW-156) is in UAT.

programmes.name: Web-Support
programmes.headline: No Web-Support ticket was created or updated in the last 30 days.

programmes.name: Devops

programmes.name: Design Marketing Development Collab
programmes.headline: The Events page title and link fix (DM-1087) closed on 13 Oct and the case-study image fix (DM-1084) is in review; the soft-404 issue on Marketplace pages (DM-1081, High) went back to In Progress. 25 items are past due, 22 of them untouched in 30 days.
